result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` is now a second name for `updateLandscape`, and `updateLandscape` still works. The `cli` module tests pass (`mvn -q -o -pl cli test`, no failures). I did not run the new help output: running the built jar needed approval I didn't have, so the `-help` and usage-overview behaviour is checked by reading the code only.

Changes:

- **`cli/.../Commands.java`**: added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE = "analyzeLandscape"` and its description, which says it is the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`. It is listed in the no-argument usage overview right after `updateLandscape`, using the same landscape options.
- **`cli/.../CommandLineInterface.java`**: both names dispatch to the same `updateLandscape` method. That method now takes the typed command name and description, so `-help` prints the usage under whichever name was typed. Behaviour and options are otherwise unchanged.
- **`README.md`**: the README had no command descriptions to update, so I added a short "Landscape" section showing `analyzeLandscape -analysisRoot <folder>`, the `_sokrates_landscape/config.json` output, and the note that `updateLandscape` is kept for existing scripts.

Nothing is committed.
